title: Foundry vs Snowflake + DBT vs Databricks for DD Analytics — Architecture Trade-Off Framework
validation_scope: 10-dimension scorecard with narrative qualifications per cell + assessment_as_of date stamps; no blanket built-in/build-yourself ratings.
3 archetype-preset weight profiles with summing-to-1 validation + weight-elicitation discipline section.
Parameterizable 5-year TCO template with REPLACE_WITH_VENDOR_QUOTE placeholders across all 3 vendor archetypes.
3 decision archetypes (large bank / mid-size advisory / PE-DD) with priorities, typical-right-answer, case-AGAINST, examiner-readiness framing.
Hybrid pattern reference architecture with boundary design decisions (data placement, sync mechanics, audit-trail boundary) + cost/complexity trade-off + operational discipline.
known_limits: Vendor state evolves quarterly; every scorecard cell carries assessment_as_of date inviting re-verification.
TCO placeholders must be replaced with current vendor quotes before procurement decisions.
Weight presets are starting points; institution must run its own elicitation process.
Decision archetypes are illustrative; most institutions are hybrids of 2 archetypes.
framing_discipline: HIGHEST PR-sensitivity article in Foundry sub-series. Discipline rules: (1) every feature claim qualified; (2) every comparison date-stamped; (3) no absolute winner framing; (4) no Gartner-as-scoring-authority citations; (5) TCO numbers are placeholders only; (6) decision archetypes carry case-AGAINST framings. Bundle does NOT recommend a vendor or endorse a weight set.
